predict.question: Your online shop adds a safeguard, plan B. On a normal day, 90% of the time, it earns 8 credits; on a failure day it loses 10. On average, what does plan B net?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Release It! treats failure containment as a design concern for production systems.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}; B averages {B}. The intervention gives up two credits in the normal branch but limits the failure loss from 100 to 10. Net branch values are stipulated; no circuit-breaker timing, bulkhead pool or real outage probability is simulated.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
